description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour, not the correct behaviour. It must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it; the wall exists now so the fix is provably a change. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. This is the `check()` half of the stage-consistency pair (#816 item 5) for saga #811's first reproduction, `print (difference 10 5)` (`difference` is a classic-Logo spelling OpenLogo does not define in any profile — measured `ol-unknown-command` under the studio's full nine-profile set too, not only under Core). Its `-execute` sibling holds the other half. This half is already CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix unchanged.
